mew3WheelPath.description: The path to the `mew3` wheel file, which will be dynamically installed when processing.

className.description:
The `mew3` class name representing the component to use in the processor.
The class will be found in the `mew3.integrations` package path.

options.description:
Initialization options for the `mew3` classes.
The options are specified as a map of class name to a map of option name to option value.
The option (if existing) corresponding to this instance's class name will be used to
initialize the class. The entire options will be passed directly as a kwarg to the
class's call.

title:
Core {@link GenaiCore.Unstructured.ProcessorComponent} to represent the integration of components from
the `mew3` library.
name: GenaiCore.Unstructured.ProcessorComponent.Mew3
